title.value: Data Standards Wales UEC Message Event

description.value: DEPRECATED. This code system will be withdrawn in a future release and SHOULD NOT be used. Any valid code system agreed with the receiving system can be used instead. This code system is used to indicate the valid message events for use within a message bundle submitting data related to an attendance at an urgent and emergency care facility.

definition.value: Indicates a message event reporting the arrival of a patient at a UEC facility.
Indicates a message event reporting the triage of a patient at a UEC facility.
Indicates a message event reporting the discharge of a patient from a UEC facility.
